text_block_list.text:
By winning the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Oaks),
and Shuka Sho, Red Desire became a Triple Tiara Umamusume.

Lately, not a day goes by without hearing her name.
She has become a true darling of the racing world.
—Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to throw a party to celebrate Desire-chan's Triple Tiara.
Would you mind lending a hand, if it's not too much trouble?

And so—
keeping Red Desire's tastes in mind, they continued preparing for the party.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! An invitation...!
This morning, inside my bag, there was an invitation
to a certain ritual...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"O bearer of the three radiances.
For your sake, on the night of the next full moon...
we shall conduct the ritual to open a new door."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Dress in formal attire befitting the ritual...
and attend with solemn readiness."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is likely for me,
having conquered the Triple Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Consider it a brand new trial!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A ritual to open a new door...?
I cannot even begin to imagine what kind of grueling hour awaits me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so!
I still wish to go.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because I am the Saint...!

I prepared this invitation to lift Red Desire's spirits
even a little—but it seems she took it as an invitation to a trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... I wonder what kind of trials
await us...!
choice_data_list: (She seems to be looking forward to it, so I guess it's fine.)

text_block_list.text: Before long, the promised evening arrived—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The ritual grounds are... this cafe, I presume.
—For this day, I have thoroughly cleansed myself
and brought the flow of mana into peak condition, you know.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Drawing strength from these pure white holy vestments...
—Now, let us depart!"

Desire-chan!
You actually achieved the Triple Tiaraâtruly, you did it!!

Congratulations!!
Congratulations.
(BAAANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: M-My goodness...! Buena-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san, and Cafe-san too...!?
Everyone, why are you...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Today's a party! Let us celebrate your Triple Tiara victory to your heart's content, Desire-chan!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A party...!?
To celebrate the Triple Tiara...
To celebrate... me...!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I took it for an ordeal...!
I was certain that a truly... severely harsh
and grueling trial awaited me...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You've worked so very hard all this time, haven't you?
Because you pushed forward with more earnest effort than anyone else...
you have achieved something truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've run alongside you all this way, so I'll be the proof.
So... just for today, let's only do fun, happy things!♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And then, we'll hype ourselves up big time here and take on the Japan Cup in the best mood ever!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup... and then, on to the Senior Class.
If it's you... I know you can achieve even greater things.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Myself, my "friends"... everyone
here is cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Blessed by those I hold dear,
the Tiara bestowed upon me...
has grown all the more radiant.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"This is truly a ritual of ecstasy.
All to take our steps toward the next stage—!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Saint Red Desire vows to never stop, giving her all to sprint across the turf from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And then, I shall conquer the world—and without fail,
reach the "Otherworld"—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... And you know what, I have a present for Desire-chan too.
From the Trainer!
choice_data_list: (Huh...! Wasn't this supposed to be from Buena...!?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Desire-chan... and Trainer, too...
You two are the stars of this party, after all ♪"

Suddenly pushed forward...
I braced myself and faced Red Desire,
holding a large bouquet behind my back.
choice_data_list: Congratulations... Looking forward to working with you going forward!
Congratulations... Let's keep doing our best together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san...!
It's all because you supported me...
that my dream of the Triple Tiara came true...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
From here on, just as always—
Let us run down this road of trials,
hand in hand together...!
(Whoosh!)

"Before I knew it,
I was surrounded by an overflowing crowd of spectators."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"There's more coming! I gave a shout
to everyone who said they wanted to celebrate."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, you are seriously loved!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I, too—love each and every one of you,
deeply, deeply... from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please, continue to stay by the side
of Holy Maiden Red Desire from here on...!
